name: Stórurð, the Giant's Rubble
why: Under the gate-shaped cliffs of Dyrfjöll to a hidden hollow where house-sized blocks of rock lie in a green meadow among turquoise ponds.
book: Free. About an hour's drive from Egilsstaðir on road 94 towards Borgarfjörður eystri; park at the facilities cabin on Vatnsskarð pass. The trail is staked; a log book and stamp wait at Stórurð.
water: Streams on the way; carry 1 litre and food, there is nothing on the route.
dangers: The first slope from the pass is steep; snowfields can last into July.
Fog comes in fast on the plateau: follow the stakes, never shortcut.
Boulder fields at Stórurð: wet rock and deep gaps between blocks.
turnaround: Not at Stórurð by 14:00, or fog hides the next stake: turn back the same way.

points.name: Vatnsskarð pass
points.note: The car park and trail board on road 94, about 430 m. Trail 9 climbs steeply at first, then runs south along the west side of Súlur.

points.name: Stórurð green ponds
points.note: About 100 m down into the hollow below Dyrfjallstindur: a 1.5 km loop among the boulders and ponds. Back the same way.
